name: Ro Charin
source:
Area: Hyogo Prefecture

A hardworking Chinese girl who works part-time as a delivery girl for a ramen store at the Chinatown. She wants to open her own ramen shop in the future. She always wears Chinese clothes to remember and honor her country while working.

Ends all of her sentences with "~aruyo".
